what: AXIS Capital writes specialty insurance and reinsurance from Bermuda: professional liability, cyber, marine, energy and credit risks for businesses, plus reinsurance for other insurers.
customers: Businesses with specialised risks, through brokers, and insurance companies buying reinsurance.
money: specialty commercial lines including professional, cyber and marine
moat: Underwriting expertise in specialty lines where pricing requires judgement rather than a rate table, and a Bermuda base that keeps the tax and capital structure efficient.
risks: Catastrophe losses can hit the reinsurance book hard in any year
Specialty pricing is softening after several profitable years
Reserve additions on old liability business remain a risk
opportunities: 8.1 times earnings and 2.9 times free cash flow with $2.6B of free cash flow
Revenue grew from $5.3B to $6.6B in four years with a 15.4% net margin
Analysts see about 14% upside, and higher bond yields raise investment income on the float
watch: The combined ratio and premium rate changes by line.
